ValidationRule.description: Avoid going back to previous statuses once you are in approval
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), !Allowed__c, TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))!="Draft" , TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c))!="Proposal", OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Draft"),ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Proposal")) , $Profile.Name != "Desktop Integration" , $Profile.Name != "System Administrator", NOT($Permission.DMT_Line_God ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot return to previous states
